description.value:
Frequency once per day

Harvest usable tissue from a creature dead less than an hour. You regain Vitae equal to 1 + half the creature’s level (minimum 1), up to your normal daily cap. A creature can be harvested this way only once.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Regaining Vitae by harvesting a corpse needs a per-source gain hook SpecialResource's schema doesn't have.
